name: Creator Studio
tagline: Bank ideas, script videos in beats, run a content calendar and keep sponsors in one place, from idea to upload.
description:
A studio for a one-person channel, shown through a worked example: Small Kitchen Science, a fictional cooking-science channel with a weekly newsletter. Every idea is banked with a hook and a score, every video gets a script written in beats (what you say, what we see, how long), and a content calendar walks each piece from Idea to Published across YouTube, Shorts, TikTok, Instagram and the newsletter.

Two finished scripts show the method, a channel strategy sets out the pillars, hook formulas and title rules, and a brand board, a media kit deck and a sponsors sheet keep the business side next to the work. The weekly newsletter row repeats itself.

Three AI recipes punch up a hook, repurpose a long video into a Short, a carousel and a newsletter section, and write title ideas. Two tools come with it: a teleprompter with mirror mode and a runtime estimate, and a title and thumbnail-text checker that previews truncation on every platform.
overview: Creator workspace: a scored idea bank, a content calendar (calendar, board, table) with a repeating newsletter, scripts in beats, a channel strategy, a brand board, a media kit deck and a sponsors sheet.
